Warranty

Register your device

Every device has a 12-month warranty whether you register or not. Registering ties the serial number to you, so if something goes wrong a claim is one email rather than a hunt for the receipt.

Finding the serial number

  • On the label on the box, next to the barcode
  • Android: Settings, About tablet (or About phone), Status, Serial number
  • Windows: Settings, System, About, or run wmic bios get serialnumber

Registering a fleet?

Email support@tugahardware.com a spreadsheet of serial numbers with your order reference and we will register them all at once.
